title.rendered: Invite Your Friends & Family to Abu Dhabi and Unlock Price on Request+ Rewards

content.rendered:
Abu Dhabi has introduced an exciting opportunity for UAE residents to welcome their loved ones while enjoying exclusive rewards. Through the Abu Dhabi Resident Friends & Family Referral Initiative 2026, eligible residents can nominate visiting friends and family members and receive reward packages worth over Price on Request when the eligibility requirements are met. 

If you’re planning to invite your parents, siblings, relatives, or friends to Abu Dhabi, this initiative makes their visit even more rewarding. While your guests enjoy one of the world’s most exciting destinations, you can receive exclusive benefits on hotels, attractions, dining, and leisure experiences.

Whether you’re arranging a Abu Dhabi tourist visa, planning holiday packages, or looking for a best travel agency to help your guests prepare for their journey, understanding how this initiative works can help you make the most of it.

What Is the Abu Dhabi Resident Friends & Family Referral Initiative?

The Abu Dhabi Resident Friends & Family Referral Initiative is an official campaign introduced by Abu Dhabi Economy and Tourism (DET) to encourage UAE residents to invite overseas friends and family to experience Abu Dhabi.

Eligible residents can nominate their visitors through the official nomination portal before they travel. Once the visitor arrives in Abu Dhabi within the campaign period and all eligibility requirements are met, the resident may receive reward packages worth more than Price on Request.

What Rewards Can You Receive?

Eligible participants can receive benefits worth more than Price on Request, including:

  • Hotel stay offers
  • Restaurant dining discounts
  • Attraction passes
  • Leisure and entertainment deals
  • Exclusive partner promotions across Abu Dhabi

Reward packages begin issuing from August 2026 and remain valid until December 31, 2026, unless individual partner offers specify different validity periods.

Who Can Participate?

Eligible UAE Residents

You can participate if you:

  • Are a UAE citizen or resident
  • Are at least 18 years old
  • Hold a valid Emirates ID

Eligible Visitors

Your nominated visitor must:

  • Live outside the UAE
  • Travel to Abu Dhabi on a valid tourist visa or qualify for visa on arrival
  • Arrive during the official campaign travel period

Campaign Timeline

Here are the important dates to remember:

  • Visitor travel period: July 20 to October 31, 2026
  • Registration deadline: September 30, 2026
  • Reward distribution: Starting August 2026
  • Reward validity: Until December 31, 2026

How the Referral Process Works

Getting started is simple.

Step 1

Register as an eligible UAE resident using your Emirates ID and personal details.

Step 2

Submit your visitor’s information, including:

  • Full name
  • Passport number
  • Nationality
  • Date of birth
  • Relationship
  • Expected arrival month

Step 3

Complete the nomination through the official Abu Dhabi nomination portal before your visitor travels.

Step 4

Once your guest arrives in Abu Dhabi during the campaign period, the arrival is automatically verified through Abu Dhabi’s authorized systems. No manual proof of arrival is required.

Important Things to Know

Before participating, keep these important conditions in mind:

  • Registration closes on September 30, 2026.
  • Visitors must arrange their own flights, accommodation, visas, and personal travel expenses.
  • The referral initiative itself does not provide visa sponsorship or visa processing.
  • Residents can submit up to five nominations per batch.
  • Each visitor can only be nominated once during the campaign.
  • Eligible residents can receive a maximum of three reward packages.

Need Help with Abu Dhabi Tourist Visa or Travel Arrangements?

While the referral initiative does not process visas or travel bookings, planning your guest’s trip is still an important part of the journey.

If your family members or friends require assistance with:

  • Abu Dhabi Tourist Visa
  • International Visa services
  • Flight bookings
  • Holiday Packages
  • Hotel reservations
  • Airport transfers
  • Abu Dhabi sightseeing tours

the experienced travel consultants at Waytransit Travels & Tourism are here to make the planning process simple and hassle-free. From helping visitors prepare for their journey to arranging memorable travel experiences in Abu Dhabi, Waytransit Travels & Tourism is committed to providing reliable support every step of the way. 

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Abu Dhabi Resident Friends & Family Referral Initiative?

It is an official campaign that allows eligible UAE residents to nominate visiting friends and family and receive reward packages worth over Price on Request when campaign requirements are met.

Who can participate?

UAE citizens and residents aged 18 years or older with a valid Emirates ID can participate by nominating eligible visitors.

Does the referral initiative provide tourist visas?

No. The initiative does not sponsor or process visas. Visitors are responsible for arranging their own visa if required.

Can I nominate more than one visitor?

Yes. Residents can submit up to five nominations per batch, although each visitor can only be nominated once during the campaign.

When do the rewards expire?

Reward packages are expected to remain valid until December 31, 2026, unless individual partner offers have different validity dates
